Per file, a type maps to a list of instances, an explicit [] when the document genuinely has no instance of the type (predicting one there is an instance false-positive), or null when the gold could not be verified for that file (metrics must SKIP null, never treat it as empty). The flat ref is unchanged and remains the value-level gold.
